measurements.baseline_source: current pedestrian counts on the existing park-edge path (manual patrol counts before any device deployment)
measurements.method: aggregate flow counters plus manual patrol cross-checks; device-level data deleted after aggregation
measurements.cadence: weekly during the pilot, monthly report
measurements.recalculation_trigger: official geometry or park implementation boundary update (organizer-side gap A-BOUNDARY-001 / A-GREEN-001)

measurements.baseline_source: submitted green_space.geojson buffer polygon, recomputed in EPSG:4548
measurements.method: polygon-area recomputation from the submitted geometry
measurements.recalculation_trigger: river blue-line verification and flood assessment (A-GREEN-001)

measurements.baseline_source: accessibility assessment of the current unsignalized crossing (to be conducted before any pilot exercise)
measurements.method: accessibility audit checklist with a named accessibility specialist
measurements.cadence: before pilot, then per audit cycle

measurements.baseline_source: current walking continuity between Wudaokou and the west end of Tsinghua East Road (submitted roads layer plus site audit)
measurements.method: route-continuity audit along the submitted low-speed link geometry
measurements.recalculation_trigger: campus boundary agreement and ground-floor use permits (A-ROAD-001 / A-PUBLIC-001)

measurements.baseline_source: current four-quadrant crossing counts around Dazhongsi Station (to be audited before design deepening)
measurements.method: pedestrian continuity audit at the four quadrants
measurements.cadence: before pilot, then per audit cycle
measurements.recalculation_trigger: rail-station planning permit and municipal utility integration (A-ROAD-001)

measurements.baseline_source: scenario-card registry in the proposal: every high-impact scenario carries a named human review channel
measurements.method: count of human-reviewed high-impact scenarios divided by all high-impact scenarios
